subject: Request: voucher portability and tiered top-up exception
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: LaunchPad Ops <ops@launchpadlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: voucher portability and tiered top-up exception

Hi Janet / LaunchPad Ops team,

Thanks again for partnering with us on Cohort 6 — the teams are seeing great early signal. I wanted to propose a narrow, one-off exception to the standard voucher rules for two reasons: 1) a sponsoring partner reallocated seats mid-program which left two early-stage teams underfunded for paid infra, and 2) the cohort has a concentrated burst of inference-heavy demos next month.

Specifically we’re asking if LaunchPad Labs will accept:
- portability of unused cohort vouchers to two named startups (transfer within the program), and
- a tiered top-up: a 30% add-on to the original voucher value for those two teams (we can cap total uplift at $5k in redwood credits per team).

This would be temporary and scoped to Cohort 6 only. If acceptable, we’d like an amendment to the credit schedule and a short mutual action plan to lock dates and invoicing. I’ve attached a draft pricing matrix showing the uplift scenarios and a proposed amendment stub to speed review (launchpad-credit-agreement.pdf; pricing_matrix.xlsx).

Key asks from LaunchPad: confirmation that your procurement/legal are OK with a limited portability clause, and an expected timeline for approval so we can commit to the teams.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
--Attachment: launchpad-credit-agreement.pdf (pdf)
--Attachment: pricing_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Janet Moore <janet@launchpadlabs.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@launchpadlabs.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: voucher portability and tiered top-up exception

Hi Priyom,

Appreciate the context and the clear proposal. A few follow-ups from procurement/legal so we can expedite:
1) Can you confirm precise language you want on the amendment (who signs, whether credits are refundable, and whether they are transferable outside the named startups)?
2) We typically require an official procurement form + PO for any monetary uplift. I’ve attached our procurement_form.pdf — if you can return a completed copy we’ll route internally.
3) Timeline: legal will need 3–5 business days to review a short amendment; procurement needs PO on file. If you can provide the redline and a narrow signature block, that will speed things.

If the intent is strictly within Cohort 6 and non-transferable beyond the two named startups, we should be able to accommodate a short addendum. If you’d like, propose the exact proposed wording and we can redact as needed.

Thanks,
Janet Moore
Head of Operations, LaunchPad Labs
--Attachment: procurement_form.pdf (pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Janet Moore <janet@launchpadlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: voucher portability and tiered top-up exception

Thanks Janet — appreciate the quick reply.

Below is the exact language we’re proposing for the amendment (lean and limited):
"
Amendment: Cohort 6 Voucher Portability & Top-up
1) Portability: Unused Cohort 6 vouchers may be reassigned by LaunchPad Labs to up to two named Cohort 6 startups (specified in Schedule A) for the purpose of fulfilling program-related infrastructure needs. Such reassignment is effective upon mutual execution of this Amendment and is limited to Cohort 6 activities only.
2) Top-up: Redwood Inference will extend a one-time top-up equal to thirty percent (30%) of the original voucher value to the reassigned vouchers, capped at USD $5,000 of Redwood credits per startup. The top-up is non-refundable and non-transferable beyond the Cohort 6 scope.
3) Execution: This Amendment will be effective upon signature by an authorized LaunchPad Labs representative and an authorized Redwood Inference representative.
"

We’ll complete your procurement_form and return it this afternoon, and I’ve attached a redline_amendment.docx that maps the language above onto your standard schedule (redline_amendment.docx). Our finance/commercial teams prefer the 30%/cap approach vs. an open dollar ask — it keeps things bounded for accounting and preserves program fairness.

If procurement wants a PO, we can generate one from Redwood that references Deal LP-2027-87 and the amendment. Proposed timeline: procurement form + PO returned today, legal review 3 business days, signatures by end of next week if no material redlines.

If that works, please confirm and we’ll start the PO.

Best,
Priyom
--Attachment: redline_amendment.docx (docx)

+1 from me — I’m fine escalating to approve the 30% top-up (within the $5k cap). Recommend we offer a 6-month runway guarantee on usage reporting and include a sunset clause so ops/legal see this as limited. Happy to sign off on the PO once procurement confirms the filled form.

—Ben
VP, Partnerships, Redwood Inference
